title: Applied? Now message the HR
caption:
Applied to 301 jobs. 0 calls. 😶

The fix isn't applying more. It's what you do AFTER applying 👇
1️⃣ Apply on the portal
2️⃣ Find who posted it (LinkedIn, Naukri, Instahyre, Wellfound)
3️⃣ Send 4 lines: "I just applied" + their name + one proof + one ask

No "Respected Sir, kindly consider my profile" 🙅

Comment HR and I'll DM you the prompt that writes it from your resume 🤖
first_comment: Comment HR 👇 and I'll DM you the message prompt. Have you ever messaged a recruiter after applying?
